suocera.aspetto: a tiny, stooped old woman in her late seventies with a deeply wrinkled face, huge bulging eyes, a hooked nose and an almost toothless mouth, in widow's black from head to toe: black headscarf, black cardigan, black skirt

parti.occhi: Red, swollen eyelids from crying, but dry, clear eyes: no fever, no sweat.

occhi_febbre.inquadratura: the eyes and the bridge of the nose, from the eyebrows to the cheekbones, the edge of the black headscarf
occhi_febbre.segni: Glassy, bloodshot eyes with fever, the eyelids red and swollen from crying, beads of sweat under the edge of the black headscarf.

parti.bocca: An almost toothless mouth with two crooked teeth and thin, pressed lips; nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: the side of her wrinkled neck under the jaw, the black headscarf pulled aside
collo.segni: A very wrinkled old neck with a thin black ribbon around it; no swelling, no lumps.

collo_febbre.inquadratura: the side of her wrinkled neck under the jaw, the black headscarf pulled aside
collo_febbre.segni: A very wrinkled old neck with a thin black ribbon around it; under the jaw a hard swollen lump the size of a walnut, red and shiny: a plague bubo just beginning.

parti.mani: Gnarled, bony old hands with swollen knuckles; dark earth under the fingernails, as if she had been kneeling at a grave, and a drop of red candle wax on one finger.
